evidence: The bug mentions runScrollSnapSelectionVerificationTest and verifySelectedSnapTarget, which are scroll-snap selection verification helpers used in APZ testing.
The report concerns split views inside collapsed tab groups being incorrectly marked hidden after session restore, matching split-view and tab-group behavior.
The crash is in nsAnimationManager::DoUpdateAnimations, the CSS animations manager, so it belongs to CSS Transitions and Animations.
The exception involves Windows API misuse in ~KeyWatcher (RegisterWaitForSingleObject/CloseHandle), which is Win32 widget code.
The report concerns styling of the URL bar input box (`.urlbar-input-box`) in RTL, which belongs to the Firefox Address Bar UI component.
The crash stack and affected code are in dom/indexedDB/ActorsParent.cpp, which is owned by Core::Storage: IndexedDB.
The report only references an unspecified bug number and gives no component clue.
Mentions application settings for file types (DMG, 7Z) and config-based prefs conversion, which relates to helper applications and file handling.
The suggested fix is in nsZipCursor::ReadOrCopy, so the zip/JAR handling component likely owns the root-cause fix.
The report concerns focus management in the site identity 'Trust panel', matching Firefox::Site Identity under Privacy Engineering.
The report concerns the 'Server Not Found' about:neterror page's message text and 'Learn More' link, which is Toolkit::Error Pages.
The report concerns the urlbar actor message path, UrlbarParentController, and search-engine observer in browser/components/urlbar, so it belongs to Address Bar.
The report explicitly asks to remove the RDM toolbar top border in split view, a CSS change owned by Responsive Design Mode.
window.open popup features are discarded by nsWindowWatcher's chrome flag calculation, which governs creation of top-level windows.
The failing test is in browser/components/customizableui and concerns toolbar overflow customization, which maps to Firefox::Toolbars and Customization under [Frontend].
The test_takeFocus.xhtml race involving DOMMenuItemActive and FocusManager mActiveItem points to focus handling.
The report ties the extra favicon.ico request specifically to opening PDF files, pointing to the built-in PDF viewer's loading behavior.
The bug affects about:neterror and net error page illustrations, which is covered by Toolkit::Error Pages under the Frontend team.
The alert reports a DAMP regression in browser-toolbox.inspector-ready, a DevTools Inspector performance test.
The bug title and discussion center on SearchWidgetTracker and the search-container widget, which are search UI code owned by Firefox::Search.
The report concerns WebAssembly Memory64 bounds-checking logic with spectre-mitigations settings.
The report is a build-system failure (mach build missing ProfilingCategoryList.h), and no build/config or profiler team is present in the team list to own the fix.
The bug is about an incorrect theme token background colour in the default light theme.
The report only says Bug 2046258 is incomplete for Thunderbird and needs an additional m-c fix, without naming a component or symptom.
The bug is about the tracking panel (Protections Panel), which is owned by Firefox::Protections UI.
The crash is reached through Intl.Collator.prototype.compare and js/src/builtin/intl/Collator.cpp, matching the JavaScript Internationalization API component.
Bug is in SERPCategorization.sys.mjs, which handles search result page categorization and is owned by the Firefox Search team.
The report describes an oversized VPN status checkbox in the overflow menu for Firefox's built-in VPN feature, which maps to Firefox::IP Protection.
Crash in js/src/wasm/WasmModule.cpp from WebAssembly.promising JSPI, matching the WebAssembly component for wasm compilation/runtime support.
The failures concern SVG animateMotion path behavior (single-moveto and zero-length subpaths), which is SVG/SMIL functionality owned by Core::SVG.
The crash is in accessible/xul/XULFormControlAccessible.cpp, specifically XULButtonAccessible::AreItemsOperable, so it belongs to the XUL accessibility implementation.
The regression is in scroll/paint performance tests on macOS with the webrender option enabled, pointing to WebRender integration.
The report identifies a root cause in servo/components/style/rule_cache.rs affecting CSS cascade computed values and @starting-style.
Mobile-only inability to scroll nested tab content points to touch-scrolling/APZ handling rather than desktop layout.
The report mentions media-triage-bot and Media+AI=padenot, indicating the Media team owns this bot formatting issue.
The leak is in widget/gtk/nsGtkKeyUtils.cpp, the GTK platform widget code corresponding to Core::Widget: Gtk.
The bug is about JIT assembler callWithABI and InitBaselineFrameForOsr, which belongs in the JavaScript JIT component.
The report concerns JXL image decoding performance, which is handled by the ImageLib component.
The assert fires in FOG::InitializeFOG (Firefox on Glean telemetry) called from StartupTelemetry, so Toolkit::Telemetry owns the fix.
The bug is a heap overflow in ANGLE's WebGL readPixels path, directly covered by the [GFX] team's ANGLE/WebGL components.
RemoteCDMChild is an EME/CDM actor handled by the Gecko Media Plugin framework.
The report concerns nsSocketTransport, HappyEyeballs, and TCP connection refusal, which is Core::Networking.

Crash occurs in style-reparenting code (RestyleManager::DoReparentComputedStyleForFirstLine calling nsIFrame::CorrectStyleParentFrame), i.e. pseudo-element computed-style inheritance for ::first-line.
Offline mode from the -offline CLI arg failing to set network state points to Necko's offline handling (Core::Networking).
The report concerns fetch interception by a service worker for requests from a dedicated worker, directly implicating the Service Workers implementation.
Bug references widget/cocoa/MOZDynamicCursor.mm and leaking NSCursor in Cocoa widget code.
Bug reports unlabeled toggles failing WCAG 4.1.2 for NVDA screen reader users in Firefox UI, which matches the accessibility-focused Firefox::Disability Access component.
The crash is in gfx/wr/webrender/src/prepare.rs with WebRender picture scratch index out of bounds.
Bug concerns Firefox VPN panel state after CFR dismissal and toolbar re-add, matching Firefox::IP Protection.
The warning is emitted from widget/gtk/ScreenHelperGTK.cpp, which is GTK widget platform code, so the fix belongs in Core::Widget: Gtk.
The crash is in dom/file/MutableBlobStorage.cpp and concerns DOM Blob/File API actor lifetime, though IPDL Send failure semantics also matter.
The bug is in Firefox's ConfirmationHint panel behavior, a browser front-end UI component with tests under browser/base/content.
The bug references dom/reporting/ReportDeliver.cpp and the Reporting API, which is a DOM Core & HTML component.
Report mentions the HTML parsing 'adoption agency algorithm' and expected DOM tree construction, which is handled by the HTML Parser component.
Crash assertion in js/src/wasm/WasmTypeDef.h during WebAssembly Ion code generation points to the WebAssembly component.
Printing in black and white ignores the setting so the printed output comes out in color, a problem in the actual printed output.
The report concerns a messaging_system.message_id telemetry impression from the Tab Groups Promo Spotlight, which belongs to the Messaging System component.
Crash frames are in modules/libjar/nsJARChannel.cpp with null gJarHandler (nsJARProtocolHandler), which belongs to the JAR protocol handler component.
The report references the shield icon's 'Clear Data' option in private browsing, which is the Anti-Tracking Protections Panel UI.
Screen reader failing to read a link in the About Firefox window indicates a Firefox UI accessibility bug.
The report concerns profile selection at startup and profiles.ini handling, matching the Toolkit startup and profile system.
The bug involves split view and tab groups, both Firefox front-end tabbed browser features covered under [Frontend].
Test file and failure message explicitly reference a source-phase wasm module compiled off the main thread.
The bug is in RTCDTMFSender.cpp, part of the WebRTC peerconnection/signaling code.
The crash stack enters SpeechRecognitionParent::InitializeParakeetContext in dom/media/webspeech/recognition, matching Core::Web Speech.
